## Installation Issue Summary / 问题描述
Describe what happened during installation or plugin selection in OptiKey.
请描述安装插件或在 OptiKey 中选择该插件时发生的具体问题。

## Environment Information / 环境信息
- **Windows Version / 系统版本**: (e.g., Windows 10 22H2 x64, Windows 11 23H2)
- **OptiKey Version / OptiKey 版本**:
- **Tobii Experience Installed? / 是否安装 Tobii 官方软件**: [Yes / No]
- **ET5 Calibration Completed in Tobii App? / 是否已在 Tobii 软件中完成校准**: [Yes / No]
- **Plugin Install Method / 插件安装方式**: (OptiKey Management Console Online Discovery / Manual ZIP Extraction)

## Symptoms / 具体现象
- [ ] Plugin does not appear in OptiKey Pointing & Selecting dropdown / OptiKey 下拉菜单未显示该插件
- [ ] Plugin appears but shows error when selected / 插件显示但选中时报错
- [ ] Tobii runtime not detected / 未检测到 Tobii 运行时 DLL
- [ ] Other / 其它现象
